Aftercare advice: Should the world seem dim for more than two weeks while life is otherwise steady, get in touch. It also matters if the music that once filled your kitchen stays silent and you find yourself crying alone in the car.

After your medication change, pay attention to your emotional wellbeing over the next few weeks. Seek help sooner should favourite hobbies start to seem pointless and give you no enjoyment.
